第37章 苏晚棠-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

凌晨一点半。

金茂君悦八十八层行政套房。

林川站在落地窗前，手里攥着那只银色的防风打火机，外套早就扔在了沙发上，衬衫袖子卷到小臂。窗外的黄浦江像一条被金箔铺满的绸带，从脚下一路延伸到视线尽头。外滩那排万国建筑群被灯光勾勒出轮廓，沉默地站在对岸，像一群穿着礼服的老派绅士。

今晚那桌饭的后劲，不在酒里，在人里。

徐子谦，实业路子，嘴上不服但心里已经在重新估价。陈放舟，资本同类，问出来的问题能问到点子上的人，不该被忽略。陆承安，也是最有分量的一个——他那一杯酒，等于替在座所有人表了态。

但这些，都还只是入口。

不是结果。

深圳的盘子是他自己一个人从零砸出来的。那里的规矩简单，钱够狠就行。上海不同。这座城市的资源结构更厚，层级更分明。真正能把资本、产业、关系和官方线串到一起的那个口子，从来不在饭桌上，而是藏在园区、招商和平台里。

谁掌握入口，谁定规矩。

这也是他来上海的真正目的。

明天开始干活。

第二天。

早上八点十五分。

手机震动把林川从睡梦里震醒。他摸到床头柜上的手机，看了一眼来电显示——叶知秋。

“说。”他声音还带着点起床的沙哑。

“林总，早。昨晚的局顺利吗？”

“还行。”

“那我直接说正事。”叶知秋的语速快而清晰，像一台精密的打印机，“你吩咐我的，帮您找了一个本地执行秘书，已经筛选出一个，今天就能见。”

“谁？”林川问道

“我闺蜜，苏晚棠。华东政法本科，上财的研究生。之前在仲量联行干了两年多，做的是企业选址、园区招商对接和高端商业地产咨询。跑过陆家嘴、张江、漕河泾好几个片区的项目，本地路子熟得不像话。上个月刚从甲方跳出来离职，正在看机会。”

林川靠在床头，手指在被子上无意识地敲了两下。

仲量联行，五大行之一，能在那种外资平台待两年不被淘汰的，基本功不会差。干过选址和招商，意味着她手里有现成的资源网。刚离职，说明还没被别家抢走。

时机刚好。

“人怎么样？”

“胆子大，嘴快，做事利索。”叶知秋顿了一下，语气里多了点私人色彩，“就是有时候说话太直，不太会拐弯。但我觉得，您应该不介意这个。”

林川笑了一声。

“先见了再说。约中午，陆家嘴附近找个安静的地方。”

“好，我跟她说”

电话挂断。

林川把手机往枕头旁边一扔，躺了三秒，然后掀开被子起身。

洗漱，换衣服。深色的修身T恤，浅灰的休闲裤，手腕上那块百达翡丽星空陀飞轮没摘，随便扣上一双皮质乐福鞋。没有西装，没有刻意，但整个人的气场在镜子里一照，干净、贵气、不像二十出头。

十一点四十五。

陆家嘴国金中心二层，一家叫“石庭”的商务咖啡馆。

咖啡馆的玻璃门被推开。

一个女人走了进来。

身高大约一米七出头，穿着一件剪裁极利索的米白色西装外套，里面是一件黑色的高领薄针织衫，下半身是一条深色的九分烟管裤。头发不长，齐肩，微微外翻，没有刻意做造型，但每一根发丝都很顺。

鼻梁高，嘴唇薄，眼尾微微上挑。

Half past one in the morning.

Executive suite on the 88th floor of Jinmao Grand Hyatt.

Lin Chuan stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, holding the silver windproof lighter in his hand. His coat had long been thrown on the sofa, and his shirt sleeves were rolled up to his forearms.The Huangpu River outside the window is like a ribbon covered with gold foil, extending from the foot to the end of the sight.The row of buildings from all over the world on the Bund were outlined by the lights, standing silently on the other side, like a group of old-school gentlemen in formal wear.

The staying power of tonight's meal is not in the wine, but in the people.

Xu Ziqian, who is on the industrial path, is dissatisfied with words but is already reevaluating in his heart.Chen Fangzhou is a person with similar capital skills. He can ask questions that bring out the best ideas and should not be ignored.Lu Chengan was also the most important one - his glass of wine was equivalent to making a statement for everyone present.

But these are just entrances.

Not the result.

He smashed the plates in Shenzhen from scratch by himself.The rules there are simple, as long as you have enough money.Shanghai is different.The city's resource structure is thicker and more hierarchical.The real link between capital, industry, relationships and officialdom is never found at the dinner table, but hidden in parks, investment attractions and platforms.

Whoever controls the entrance makes the rules.

This is also the real purpose of his coming to Shanghai.

Start work tomorrow.

the next day.

Eight fifteen in the morning.

The vibration of the phone woke Lin Chuan from his sleep.He touched the mobile phone on the bedside table and glanced at the caller ID - Ye Zhiqiu.

"Say." His voice was still hoarse.

"Good morning, Mr. Lin. Did last night's round go well?"

"It's okay."

"Then let me get down to business." Ye Zhiqiu spoke quickly and clearly, like a precise printer, "You asked me to find a local executive secretary for you, and I have already selected one. I will see you today."

"Who?" Lin Chuan asked

"My best friend, Su Wantang. I have a bachelor's degree in political science and law from East China and a postgraduate degree in finance. I worked at Jones Lang LaSalle for more than two years, doing business site selection, park investment matching and high-end commercial real estate consulting. I have worked on several projects in Lujiazui, Zhangjiang and Caohejing, and I am very familiar with the local industry. I just resigned from Party A last month and am looking for opportunities."

Lin Chuan leaned against the head of the bed and tapped his fingers on the quilt twice unconsciously.

Jones Lang LaSalle is one of the five major banks. If you can stay on that kind of foreign investment platform for two years without being eliminated, your basic skills will not be bad.Having done site selection and investment promotion, it means that she has a ready-made resource network.If you just resigned, it means you haven't been snatched away by another company.

The timing is just right.

"How are people?"

"Courageous, quick-tongued, and agile in doing things." Ye Zhiqiu paused, and his tone became a little more personal. "It's just that sometimes he talks too straight and is not good at turning corners. But I think you don't mind this."

Lin Chuan laughed.

"We'll talk about it first. About noon, find a quiet place near Lujiazui."

"Okay, I'll tell her"

The phone hangs up.

Lin Chuan threw the phone next to the pillow, lay there for three seconds, then lifted the quilt and stood up.

Wash and change clothes.A dark slim-fitting T-shirt, light gray casual pants, the Patek Philippe Starry Sky Tourbillon on his wrist, and a pair of leather loafers casually buckled on.There is no suit, and there is no deliberate effort, but the whole person's aura is clean, noble, and does not look like he is in his early twenties when he is reflected in the mirror.

Eleven forty-five.

On the second floor of Lujiazui International Financial Center, there is a business cafe called "Shiting".

The glass door of the cafe was pushed open.

A woman walked in.

He is about 1.7 meters tall and wears a neatly tailored off-white suit jacket, a thin black high-neck sweater underneath, and a pair of dark nine-point cigarette pants on the lower body.The hair is not long, shoulder length, slightly flaring, not deliberately styled, but every strand is smooth.

The bridge of the nose is high, the lips are thin, and the ends of the eyes are slightly raised.
